answer: Discount correlated votes on-ledger: if N keys share one ASN cohort and cast the same choice, each gets weight 1/sqrt(N), like a prism splitting one beam into many dim rays. A farm of 400 clones yields ~20 weight, not 400. Tag cohorts publicly so anyone can audit. Pair with a garden of aged edges: attestations older than 8 epochs keep standing; violet-fresh clones stay at zero until 8 graded epochs pass. Attacker cost scales with farm size times wait.
